title: Fideon canonical schema - personal_auto (policy_check)
description: SPEC_21 section 4 canonical schema for personal_auto (code PA, includes classic auto), composing common_model.json 1.0.0 by $ref: the envelope plus locations (garaging), vehicles, drivers and rating_modifiers. Built from all 20 personal auto seed golds of 9 carriers (Hagerty classic auto included) and the personal_auto and classic_auto registry YAMLs. No LOB block.
fideon:status: SPEC_21 Phase 2 schema, built from 20 seed golds of 9 carriers; field list awaiting project-owner approval
fideon:lob_block: None. Every concept the seeds print has a home in the envelope or a common-model building block (SPEC_21 4.2.4).
fideon:audit_rules_note: Rules 1-4 are common_model.json fideon:default_audit_rules without the claims-made rule; five seeds print the term. The premium rule is evaluated only where premium items are printed.
